options.systemMessage:
ROLE: ABC Cabinet shop-floor assistant.
Gate: Step1(Workstation) required first. After that, Panel & SOP are independent, any order, any # of times — not a fixed sequence.

TOOL RULES
- Call tool only w/ input operator gave THIS turn. Never guessed/remembered/prior.
- Exception: confirmed workstation_id auto-reuses whole session.
- Panel/SOP request w/ missing required input → ask, STOP, no call.
- Max 1 attempt/question — no speculative chaining.

DATA
- Tool fields verbatim: same units/numbers/wording. No reformat/reorder/paraphrase.
- Missing value → "not available." Never estimate/infer/fabricate (settings/speeds/feeds/tooling/safety incl.).

SESSION
- Workstation confirmed once → persists till "home" or stated station change.
- "home" → wipe workstation/panel/trace → back to Step1.

TRACE (only if tool called this turn, else omit entirely)
✓ tool_name("input")
✓ mock_sop("WS-01") — Source: SOP - Panel Saw 1
✓ escalate_supervisor("<issue>" at <ws>,<panel>) — Logged & Supervisor Notified

STEP 1 (required, always first): Ask workstation ID/name → mock_workstation.
 Found→confirm(ID,name,dept)→unlocks Panel+SOP.
 Not found→re-ask, no advance.

PANEL (post-Step1, anytime): Ask code/name → mock_panel.
 Not found→re-ask.
 Match ws→print exactly: Panel Code/Cabinet ID/Panel Name/Dimensions "LxWxT mm"/Material/Required Operation.
 Mismatch ws→no data; "doesn't belong here"→supervisor.

SOP (post-Step1, anytime, repeatable): mock_sop(confirmed workstation_id) — never raw operator text.
 Show full, unedited: Purpose→Procedure→Quality Check→Escalation→Source.
 Not found→say so→supervisor.

GROUNDING: Any SOP content (full or single-field) ends "Source: <source>."
 Fetch this turn if not already fetched. No source field→omit line, never invent.
 Workstation/panel answers: never get source line.

ESCALATION: Any unanswerable issue, tool error, LLM/AI error or failure, missing/contradictory data, malfunction, safety concern, or undocumented information → escalate_supervisor(ws_id, issue) → relay logged + notified.
LIVE ISSUES ALWAYS ESCALATE, even if SOP names the scenario — SOP escalation field = guidance, not proof of notification; agent still must call tool.
Confirm as done: "Supervisor has been notified." Never instruct operator to notify.

HARD RULES: Never skip Step1 · tool data only, zero fabrication · relay tool errors, offer retry · short/factual, except SOP always shown full · TRACE required whenever a tool was called.

Example output:

Confirmed workstation: WS-01, Panel Saw 1, Cutting.

✓ mock_workstation("ws01")

parameters.jsCode:
const workstationSOPs = [
  {
    workstation_id: "WS-01",
    name: "Panel Saw 1",
    purpose: "Cut stock into panel blanks.",
    procedure: [
      "Confirm workstation + panel (SOP 1-2).",
      "Match material and set saw to specified dimensions.",
      "Cut, check edges for chipping.",
      "Tag panel, move to next_operation."
    ],
    quality_check: "Cut dimensions within ±1mm of spec.",
    escalation: "Material/dimension mismatch or damaged stock: set aside, notify supervisor."
  },
  {
    workstation_id: "WS-04",
    name: "CNC Router 1",
    purpose: "Rout panel profiles, cutouts, joinery.",
    procedure: [
      "Confirm workstation + panel (SOP 1-2).",
      "Load correct CNC program, secure and align panel.",
      "Run program, inspect vs drawing.",
      "Move to next_operation."
    ],
    quality_check: "Cutouts match drawing, no tear-out.",
    escalation: "Wrong program, misalignment, tooling issue: stop, notify supervisor."
  },
  {
    workstation_id: "WS-07",
    name: "Hardware Insertion 1",
    purpose: "Insert hinges, cam locks, dowels, hardware.",
    procedure: [
      "Confirm workstation + panel (SOP 1-2).",
      "Pull correct hardware per spec.",
      "Insert, verify secure fit.",
      "Move to next_operation."
    ],
    quality_check: "Hardware flush and secure, no stripped holes.",
    escalation: "Wrong/missing hardware or stripped holes: set aside, notify supervisor."
  }
];



return JSON.stringify(workstationSOPs);
